jobs.occupation: Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager (Laborleiter/in)
jobs.description: The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.The Division of Soft-Tissue Sarcoma at the Hopp Children’s Cancer Center (KiTZ) - a joint institution of the Heidelberg University Hospital and the German Cancer Research Center - is seeking, starting between December 2026 and January 2027, a Laboratory Technician / Laboratory Manager.Your TasksWe are a friendly and motivated laboratory with German and international researchers working to understand tumor biology and generate new models to help find treatments for children and adults with sarcoma. The candidate’s tasks will comprise lab management, cell culture, plasmid preps, support in various molecular biology techniques and training of new laboratory members on specifc tasks when required. Occasional mouse work may be required. Routine animal work is covered by a dedicated technician, with the successful candidate only expected to assist during periods of absence or in exceptional circumstances. While the position involves both administrative and laboratory work, there is some flexibility in the balance between these two areas, depending on the successful candidate’s interests. The candidate will work together with other members of the laboratory and will be trained in the various tasks.Your ProfileThe ideal candidate should:- Be motivated, responsible, and well organised- Have completed vocational training as a biological laboratory technician or hold a comparable qualification- Have experience in cell culture and standard molecular biology techniques- Have basic experience in handling mice, ideally hold a FELASA certificate- Be willing to train technical trainees and early-career scientists in specific laboratory techniques- Have a working knowledge of English and German- Have good communication skills and the ability to document laboratory work accuratelyWHAT MAKES THIS POSITION SPECIAL- Training in a range of laboratory techniques- An interesting and varied role, with the opportunity to contribute actively, alongside the wider research group, to laboratory organisation and the group’s future development- Friendly, collaborative, and international working environment- Workplace in the new KiTZ building and access to the modern, state-of-the-art infrastructure of the DKFZ campus- Opportunities for continuing education, professional development, and career progressionWe Offer- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level- 30 days of vacation per year- Flexible working hours- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments- Possibility of part-time work- Family-friendly working environment- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-beingAre you interested?Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!Contact:Dr. Ana BanitoPhone: +49 (0)6221/42-1581​Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.Application Deadline: November 4, 2026Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. People with severe disabilities are given preference if they have the same aptitude.Notice: We are subject to the regulations of the Infection Protection Act (IfSG). Therefore, all our employees must provide proof of immunity against measles.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day In this role, you are responsible for the efficient and accurate preparation of quotations for the global surge arrester market. Your proposals are based on customer-specific technical requirements, established product solutions, and applicable framework agreements.You support both internal and external stakeholders by providing timely clarifications and ensuring a high level of customer service throughout the quotation process. In addition, you are responsible for the accurate processing and booking of customer orders, thereby ensuring a seamless transition from sales to execution.Through your structured, process-oriented approach, you enable regional sales colleagues to further develop business opportunities and strengthen customer relationships. The quality, accuracy, and reliability of your work form the foundation for the efficient execution of downstream operational processes.You collaborate closely with colleagues across the organization, actively engage with adjacent functions on complex topics, communicate transparently, and contribute to the continuous improvement of existing processes by constructively challenging established ways of working.Your daily work is supported by SAP, including a powerful integrated configuration tool, as well as the Microsoft Office suite.How You’ll Make an Impact * Commitment to delivering high customer satisfaction, exceptional service quality, and sustainable business growth* Active contribution to process optimization and continuous improvement initiatives* Support and promotion of a collaborative learning culture and knowledge sharing environment* Customer-centric service excellence and responsiveness to evolving market requirements* Ownership and accountability for operational effectiveness and business success* Dedication to advancing the transition toward a CO₂-free and sustainable energy futureWhat You Bring* Advanced technical understanding of energy transmission and distribution components and applications* Strong commitment to professional development, continuous learning, and effective communication* Rapid comprehension of complex topics and proficiency in utilizing IT tools, including SAP and MS Office* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English* Strong teamwork and collaboration capabilities within cross-functional and international environments* Proactive and committed working style, combined with a high level of adaptability and initiative About the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the X-Labs department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for aInternship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Systems Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the X-Labs department, as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn- Start: as soon as possible- Duration: 6 months- Within the X-Labs organization, we are targeting advanced technological breakthroughs that could be key enablers of the next generation products at Airbus.By exploration of new air vehicle concepts and application of disruptive technology bricks we are driving a step change in air vehicle performance and allowing us to significantly rethink air vehicle design. These advances are opening up the design space and enabling us to look at new concepts and new markets previously impossible to envisage.Your locationOur site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilitiesWe are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Flight Controls Engineering Intern to join our dynamic flight systems team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands-on experience designing, testing, and integrating advanced flight control systems for our next-generation aircraft. Mentored by senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects, applying theoretical aerospace concepts to real-world hardware and software challenges.- Flight Control Law Development & Simulation: Assist in the design, modeling, and refinement of flight control laws to meet performance and handling requirements.- Develop FCC dynamic algorithms: Design and optimize dynamic algorithms for the Flight Control Computer (FCC) to ensure reliable aircraft responsiveness.- Implement control strategies in MATLAB/Simulink: Translate aerodynamic data and control theory into high-fidelity digital models.- Conduct Software-In-The-Loop (SIL) simulations to validate control architecture stability: Run rigorous tests to analyze system performance and safety margins.- Hardware: Lead trade studies to evaluate, select, and integrate core flight control hardware for your specific project scope, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and the FCC.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.- Language skills: English Fluent, good German skills would be an advantage.- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.- Previous project team experience (e.g., Design Build Fly, Formula SAE, university rocketry/UAV teams).- Familiarity with simulation environments like Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).- Exposure to hardware integration, avionics, or basic embedded systems.- Eagerness to learn and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? jobs.occupation: Founding CTPO | Co-Founder Opportunity (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:CPO; Chief-Product-Officer; Product OwnerStellenbeschreibung:About HeyGermanyGermany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.The RoleWe are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.What You’ll Do- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.What We’re Looking For- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.What We Offer- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.katharina@hey-germany.com (https://mailto:katharina@hey-germany.com)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers-and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.Be part of Getinge as aQuality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and ComplianceWe are currently looking for an experienced Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance to join our Quality department in Aschheim-Dornach, Germany, or Solna, Sweden, part of the Critical Care product area at Getinge. This role will support the organization as the internal audit process owner, CAPA coordinator, and QA specialist, while continuously improving our quality management system and supporting quality-related projects (e.g., implementation of new tools, CAPA, etc.).Own the internal audit process, plan the annual internal audit schedule, and follow up on internal audit findingsConduct internal audits as an internal auditorSupport of external audits (notified bodies, authorities, customers)Support of CAPA projects as CAPA coordinatorCollaboration in and owning internal Quality projects (management system plan, CAPA)Continuous contribution to process improvement and alignment with other Critical Care sitesProvision and reporting of monthly KPIsMaintenance, review and approval of QMS-related documentation and records as QA specialistDegree in medical technology, engineering, science, or a similar relevant fieldMinimum 3 years of hands-on experience in quality and environmental management, ideally in an ISO 13485 environmentRelevant knowledge of the implementation and application of applicable standards and regulationsProven external and/or internal training in QM / ISO 13485 / FDA / EU MDRIdeally trained as an Internal AuditorDemonstrated experience in Quality- and Environmental-related projects (e.g., CAPAs, EU MDR uplift) is an advantageFluency in written and spoken English; Swedish or German (depending on the location) is an advantageOn-site presence of at least 1-2 days per week is expected; willingness to travel is requiredIn addition to your technical expertise, we highly value your personality. We believe you are a result-oriented and collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work and can operate independently when needed. You have strong analytical skills, a pragmatic mindset, and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels, and cultures. You thrive in a changing environment and approach challenges with professionalism and diplomacy.We think you have an ambition for continuous development and a strong interest in staying up to date with the latest trends, regulations, and best practices within Quality Management, Medical Devices, and Supplier Quality.At Getinge, we see ourselves as Team Players, Forward Thinkers, and Game Changers. We value proactive individuals who contribute to continuous improvement and organizational development.We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits, and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.Most importantly, this is a role where you can truly make a difference by contributing to the quality and safety of life-saving medical devices while helping shape the future of quality and compliance within Getinge.
